stories.topicLabel: Seattle police chief relieved of duties
stories.analysis: The two outlets framing this story diverged notably in emphasis and political coloring. Al Jazeera's headline — "Police chief resigns days after deadly shooting in US city of Seattle" — uses the neutral verb "resigns" and grounds the story in a factual sequence of events, treating the departure as a straightforward news development. Fox News, by contrast, labels the mayor a "democratic socialist" rather than using a party affiliation or neutral title, a characterization our scorers flagged as a political attack signal rather than a descriptive one. Fox also describes the chief as "embattled" — a loaded term absent from the more neutral coverage — and appends "Black protest planned," framing the story around anticipated racial unrest. Where Al Jazeera centers the shooting as context, Fox centers political identity and social tension, producing a bias spread of 3.5 points between the two headlines.
